features: Adds a bell beside every live price for creating a one-shot Telegram price alert.
Automatically decides ABOVE/BELOW direction from the current price and the target price.
Stores active alerts in R2 so the bell state is shared across devices.
While monitor.html is open, the Worker checks active alerts every 10 seconds; an optional Cloudflare every-minute cron keeps alerts working when the page is closed.
On a successful Telegram send, the triggered alert is automatically deleted.
Telegram message format is: SYMBOL   觸發TARGET followed by Taiwan time.
Integrate MultiAssetLiquidityRadar v1.1.3 as an independent GitHub Pages subfolder using the parent SState monitor-engine.js.
Main navigation: replace quick 即時監控 with 清算監控 (new tab); move original 即時監控 link into 更多.
Watch MultiAssetLiquidityRadar/** in GitHub Pages deployment workflow so subsequent radar-only pushes redeploy.

Liquidity radar v1.1.4 adds per-symbol Telegram price-alert bells beside symbol labels; reuses existing SState Worker /api/monitor/alerts R2 storage, Telegram secrets and one-shot deletion without creating a second system.
WTI_USDT_PERP alert TradingView ticker aliases to PIONEX:CLUSDT.P in the Cloudflare Worker (requires Worker redeployment for WTI alerts).
